# Timedshot
Timedshot is a low-cost, no-code tool for scheduling automated
screenshots of webpages and receiving timestamped PDF proof.

## Key facts
- Pricing: $12 CAD/mo (15 URLs), $25 CAD/mo (40 URLs), custom enterprise
- Scheduling: weekly, biweekly, every 29/30 days, or a specific date
- Output: timestamped PDF, emailed and stored for 60 days
- No code, no API integration required
- 15-day free trial, no credit card

## Use case: Employers hiring foreign workers in Canada (LMIA / TFWP)
Employers hiring foreign workers in Canada — including those applying
for a Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA) under the Temporary
Foreign Worker Program (TFWP) — must keep dated proof of job postings
throughout the recruitment period. Timedshot automates this by
capturing a timestamped PDF of a job posting on a weekly
schedule. Users are responsible for downloading and retaining their
PDFs for the full record-retention period required by their LMIA
stream (up to six years) since Timedshot only stores captures for 60
days. Timedshot cannot reliably capture some job sites — including
Indeed, Glassdoor, and Eluta — which may block automated screenshot
capture; users advertising on those platforms should verify captures
work or keep a manual backup. Timedshot is not a legal or compliance
service and does not guarantee LMIA approval or compliance.
